title: Shantiniketan
hero_alt: Shantiniketan at dusk, almost hidden behind a garden of trees
about: A family home in Indore wrapped in a perforated terracotta screen. The brick lets light and breeze through to the rooms behind it, and glows like a lantern after dark. Inside, a double-height living room steps down into a sunken seating well.
